note: Public Monero remote nodes on their restricted RPC, verified with POST /json_rpc get_info returning mainnet and status OK, get_fee_estimate, get_block_headers_range, a pruned get_blocks.bin read of one scan batch, and the full get_output_distribution.bin a send reads its decoys from. The later rows come from the monero.fail, Feather and Cake Wallet lists. Every shipped row is TLS with a CA-valid certificate, because the client accepts no other: the MoneroDevs, StormyCloud, HashVault and xmr.support nodes now present self-signed certificates and xmr-tw an expired one, so they are omitted. A plaintext node is reachable only when the user adds it and marks it insecure. Scanning is client-side with the view key, so no secret ever reaches the node; the node only learns which block ranges were requested. A user who minds that metadata should point Jelly at their own node.
